sentence: This project gets a system that detects and measures biomarkers, contaminants, and therapeutic drugs in biological and environmental samples.
This project tries to find out how genetic variation across the kinome changes kinase function, using experimental measurements and computational predictions.
This project studies the biobehavioral causes of cancer risk and response, and how to improve cancer outcomes, cancer care delivery and policy.
This project uses direct electrical measurements on mitochondrial membranes to study how the mitochondrial calcium uniporter opens and closes.
This project studies how leukotriene B4 changes the electrical properties of the heart in type 2 diabetes and leads to abnormal heart rhythms.
This project tries to make it faster and more reliable to decide what DNA changes in cancer risk genes mean.
This project studies how too much of a complement protein upsets the balance of excitation and inhibition in epilepsy, using animal models and human tissue.
This project uses CRISPR to delete genes in the fungus Coccidioides and tests which genes it needs to cause disease.
This project tries to define flares in a late-onset inflammatory blood disease, using patients from a clinical trial and other groups.
This project studies how virus and bacteria exposures and many kinds of biological data together affect asthma exacerbations in children and adults.
This project predicts the structures of proteins and protein complexes with deep learning to help form ideas about how cancer works.
This project studies how a protein that binds RNA is controlled during DNA damage and transcriptional stress, using microscopy and sequencing.
This project builds a treatment that uses biodegradable polymer beads to restore elasticity in pelvic tissues affected by pelvic organ prolapse.
This project studies how human papilloma virus DNA joined to tumor genomes changes the host transcriptome and when it drives cancer progression.
This project sets up a unit that supports a consortium studying liquid biopsy for early cancer by coordinating work and managing data.
This project builds a way to take large, detailed 3D images of tumor microenvironments to study how cancer cells and immune cells interact.
This project studies how HIV particles assemble and mature and how drugs that block maturation work.
This project adapts magnetic resonance imaging to measure how much oxygen the brain extracts in people with vascular contributions to dementia.
This project uses computational techniques to find causes of Alzheimer's disease and tests the top ideas in excitatory neurons, microglia and forebrain organoids.
This project studies how the vaginal microbiome and human genes together affect spontaneous preterm birth, using paired genotype and microbiome data.
